full_judgment: 47. A deed of sale prepared and executed after much thought and deliberation and finally concluded by registration is a solemn act transferring right and title to the person whose name appears as transferee in the deed. The presumption carries with the registration not only that it was duly and regularly so done but also the state of things as recited in the deed is the real state of things and it is the named transferee who purchased the land by his money. Such presumption is of course rebuttable.
